description: Implementation of QuicChromiumClientStream class handling QUIC stream operations, headers, data, and stream lifecycle management within Chromium's network stack.

classes.name: ScopedBoolSaver
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily set a boolean value and restore it when out of scope.

classes.name: QuicChromiumClientStream
classes.description: Represents a QUIC stream in Chromium, managing headers, data, and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: QuicChromiumClientStream::Handle
classes.description: Handle class providing an interface to interact with the stream, manage callbacks, and handle stream events.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a new handle for the stream, optionally notifying it of initial headers.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Called when initial headers are received; processes headers and notifies handle.

methods.name: OnTrailingHeadersComplete
methods.description: Called when trailing headers are received; processes headers and notifies handle.

methods.name: OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Called when body data is available; notifies handle if appropriate.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure, notifying handle and cleaning up.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Called when the stream is writable; notifies handle.

methods.name: WritevStreamData
methods.description: Writes multiple buffers to the stream.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer.

methods.name: NotifyHandleOfInitialHeadersAvailableLater
methods.description: Posts a task to notify handle of initial headers availability.

methods.name: NotifyHandleOfTrailingHeadersAvailableLater
methods.description: Posts a task to notify handle of trailing headers availability.

methods.name: NotifyHandleOfDataAvailableLater
methods.description: Posts a task to notify handle of data availability.

methods.name: DeliverEarlyHints
methods.description: Delivers early hints headers if available.

methods.name: DeliverInitialHeaders
methods.description: Delivers initial headers to the handle.

methods.name: DeliverTrailingHeaders
methods.description: Delivers trailing headers to the handle.

methods.name: DisableConnectionMigrationToCellularNetwork
methods.description: Disables connection migration to cellular network.

methods.name: IsFirstStream
methods.description: Checks if the stream is the first stream.
